# LOG-5: Log time never goes backwards, and data sampled earlier says when

- TimeUS is when the message was written and stays monotonic, so messages can be compared. Data sampled at another time carries its own sample-time field, so analysis and Replay can line it up.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Logging and GCS Messages](../claude/CLAUDE.md#logging-and-gcs-messages). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
